attributes.name: fftsettings
attributes.digest: FFT Settings
attributes.description: FFT settings consist of three numbers representing the window size, hop size and FFT size in samples: The hop size and fft size can both be set to -1 (and are by default), with slightly different meanings: Constraints For the hop size, -1 = For the FFT size, -1 =snapped to the nearest equal / greater power of 2 (e.g.=>, butalso =>) FFTSize, if != -1, will snap to the next greatest power of two > 4 The maximum FFT size is limited to the value of theargument if FFT size != -1, then window size is clipped at FFT size

attributes.digest: Filter Size
attributes.description: The size (in hops) of a smoothing filter that is applied on the novelty curve. A larger filter size allows for cleaner cuts on very sharp changes. Constraints Minimum: Maximum: Snaps to odd numbers

attributes.name: metric
attributes.digest: Spectral Change Metric
attributes.description: The metric used to derive a difference curve between spectral frames. It can be any of the following:

choices.label: thresholds on (sum of squares of magnitudes / nBins) (like Onsets power)
thresholds on (sum of (squared magnitudes * binNum) / nBins)
thresholds on (difference in magnitude between consecutive frames, half rectified)
thresholds on (sum of log of magnitude ratio per bin) (or equivalently, sum of difference of the log magnitude per bin) (like Onsets mkl)
thresholds on (cosine distance between comparison frames)
takes the past 2 frames, projects to the current, as anticipated if it was a steady state, then compute the sum of the differences, on which it thresholds (like Onsets phase)
same as PhaseDev, but weighted by the magnitude in order to remove chaos noise floor (like Onsets wphase)

same as PhaseDev, but in the complex domain - the anticipated amp is considered steady, and the phase is projected, then a complex subtraction is done with the actual present frame. The sum of magnitudes is used to threshold (like Onsets complex)
same as above, but rectified (like Onsets rcomplex)
